page_note: 该页为 Swiss Re Institute sigma 1/2025 第7页，正文讨论2024年巨灾损失，中部为 Figure 3 的水平堆积条形图（按灾种分解2024年与历年平均保险损失）。

heading.title: Global insured losses from natural catastrophes in 2024 and previous year averages

components.evidence: each average row is one bar split into coloured peril segments, bar length is the total
category labels '30-year average (1994-2023)' ... '2024' on the left, bars grow rightward
vertical rules at 0,10,...,140 cross the bars; no horizontal grid lines drawn
two legend rows 'Earthquakes ... Severe convective storms' / 'Floods  Other secondary perils' under the axis
'Source: Swiss Re Institute' in small print below the legend
heading line '(USD bn, 2024 prices)'; axis ticks are bare numbers 0 to 140
the whole figure block, plot area included, sits on a pale blue tint instead of white
wildfire and earthquake segments only a few pixels wide, no room for any label

new_components.name: stacked_segment_requires_difference
new_components.evidence: segment values readable only as the gap between two cumulative boundaries on the 0-140 axis
new_components.why_it_matters: 每个分段值必须由两个累计边界相减得到，误差叠加，5-10 之类的小段几乎无法在5%内读出。

new_components.name: figure_container_tint_box
new_components.evidence: figure number, heading, plot, legend and source all enclosed in one full-width pale blue box
new_components.why_it_matters: 标题与图区共处一个彩色容器且左右并列，解析器容易把标题当成独立段落而与表格脱钩。

difficulty_notes: 图上无任何数值标签，全部要靠像素读数：0-140 的轴宽约 495 px，10 个单位仅约 35 px，即 1 单位≈3.5 px。而堆积段必须由两条累计边界相减，误差翻倍；对 5、7、9 这类小段，5% 容差分别只有 0.25、0.35、0.45 个单位，即不到 1.6 px，远小于分段边界与描边的宽度。相比之下行标签（'30-year average (1994-2023)' 等）与图例名称清晰，两个键即可唯一定位一个段，标签层压力小得多。
